title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
压力瞬间来到了威廉.斯蒂芬这边。而鉴于他刚才用不太光彩的方式害死了卢克.邓肯，威廉.斯蒂芬知道，这个印第安少女或许会放过老鲍勃，但绝对不会放过他的。他只能靠自己才能活命！！“不要过来。”用手臂勒着罗伯特的脖子，将他的身体又朝自己靠拢了一点，这位FBI助理主管此刻表现得色厉内荏，就像是抓住最后一根救命稻草的溺水之人。他在赌米娜会因为在乎他弟弟的性命而投鼠忌器，最后只能放他离去。他这番想法倒确实没错，米娜确实很在乎自己的家人。但一直以来都是在跟那些普通罪犯打交道的威廉.斯蒂芬，很显然忘了一点，又或者说他暂时没能把思维转换过来。在他面前的并不是一个普通人，而是一个货真价实的超凡者！！这些对普通人来说有用的威胁招数，遵照经验主义用在一名他不了解的超凡者身上，只会如同纸糊般可笑。霎那间，威廉.斯蒂芬就发现自己身体动不了了。顺着狂风吹进机舱，拍打在他身上的雨水，同样在米娜这位受到神明恩赐的巫女控制范围内。在威廉.斯蒂芬惊恐的目光下，他身上出现了一条条细小的蓝色水蛇。这些水蛇宛若活物般在他身上快速游走着，转眼间就把他五花大绑起来。上帝啊！！透过后视镜悄悄观察的老鲍勃看到这一幕眼睛睁大，差点没忍住叫了出来。好在他忍住了，挺着个大肚子缩在座位上，尽量降低自己的存在感。但想想这样貌似还不太保险，老鲍勃可不想自己的孩子还有妻子明天在阵亡者名单上看到自己的名字。他主动开口，透露了一个情报：“女巫小姐，你另外几名同伴刚才乘坐我同事的直升机离开了，我猜测，他们应该会先被送到费城警察局里。”“……谢谢。”虽然知道对方是迫于形势才向自己示好，但米娜还是很有礼貌地点了点头，朝他表示了感谢。这友善的态度让老鲍勃一颗悬着的心放回了肚子里。他非常识趣地闭上嘴，在自己座位上当起了透明人，不去理会后面机舱发生了什么。而米娜对于这个害死卢克表哥的凶手，就没有这么客气了。她朝着对方抬了抬手。顿时间，威廉.斯蒂芬四肢张开呈大字，身体漂浮在半空中，脖子以下的部位全部被蓝色水流包裹。

一个个由水流形成的细小漩涡如同锋利刀锋，从威廉.斯蒂芬双脚开始，一点点刮下他身上的皮肤和血肉。即使威廉.斯蒂芬身为FBI特工，接受过专门的反审讯训练，还是在这种恐怖的凌迟刑罚中痛得发狂。刚才还在绞尽脑汁思考、怎么样才能活下来的他，此刻脑子里只剩下一个念头。“杀了我，杀了我！！！”威廉.斯蒂芬状若恶鬼般抬起头大喊。“不，这是你应得的惩罚。”米娜声音平静，带着碧绿色青铜面具，漂浮在空中的神圣样子，竟然跟刚才在蜃景中主持祭祀仪式的阿兹特克大祭司有几分相似。平时话很多的罗伯特也被这股气势所慑，有些吃惊地瞪大眼睛，望着跟平时气质完全不一样的姐姐。他觉得姐姐现在的样子简直酷毙了，就像电影里面那些用魔法惩戒敌人的漂亮女巫一样。“啊！啊啊——”而在承受了差不多四百多刀，包裹威廉.斯蒂芬的蓝色水流完全变成了红色时，这位渴望进步的FBI助力主管的生命终于走到了尽头。临死前，他还不忘朝面前这对印第安姐弟发出最恶毒的诅咒。“联邦政府还有那些财阀是不会放过你们的，你们最后的结果会跟卢克.邓肯一样，死在某个角落，最后尸体被送上解剖台……”“咔嚓。”米娜没让他继续说下去。她冷着脸，操控水流扭断了威廉.斯蒂芬的脖子。……与此同时。银行附近。卢克庞大的巨人身躯就倒在了这里。因为刚才异象被吸引过来的吃瓜群众们，参与战斗的胆子没有，但站在巨人尸体旁边，拍照打卡上传社交媒体的胆子还是大大滴有的。甚至于短短十几分钟内，有人心发现了商机，附近多出了十几个合影地点。例如之前克里斯所在的商业百货大楼，因为视野好，能基本拍到巨人的全身，被两伙帮派成员联手抢占，合影一次收费五十刀。人们一边骂骂咧咧，高呼巨人是大家的，一边爽快从钱包里掏钱，乐此不疲凹造型留念。毕竟他们也不想五十年后回想今晚，因一时囊中羞涩，失去了照片留念，向孙子吹牛逼的机会。而和这群没心没肺的美国吃瓜群众不同，费城警察局里，今年年仅四十七岁的费城警察局局长丹尼尔·奥特洛忧心忡忡。
content_en:
The pressure instantly came to William Stephen's side.And since he had just killed Luke Duncan in a disgraceful way, William Stephen knew that this Indian girl might let old Bob go, but she would never let him go.He can only survive on his own!!"Don't come over." He strangled Robert's neck with his arms and moved his body closer to him. The FBI assistant director acted stern and inwardly at this moment, like a drowning man grasping the last straw.He was betting that Mina would be so concerned about his brother's life that she would eventually let him go.His thoughts were indeed correct, Mina did care about her family.But William Stephen, who had always been dealing with ordinary criminals, had obviously forgotten something, or he had not been able to change his thinking for the time being.The person in front of him was not an ordinary person, but a genuine extraordinary person!!These threatening tactics that are useful to ordinary people will only be as ridiculous as paper when used on an extraordinary being that he does not understand based on empiricism.In an instant, William Stephen found that he could not move his body.The rain that blew into the cabin along with the strong wind and slapped on his body was also within the control of Mina, a witch gifted by the gods.Under William Stephen's horrified eyes, tiny blue water snakes appeared on his body.These water snakes swam quickly on his body like living creatures, and tied him up in the blink of an eye.God!!Old Bob, who was quietly observing through the rearview mirror, opened his eyes wide when he saw this scene, and almost couldn't help but scream.Fortunately, he held it back and huddled in his seat with his big belly, trying to reduce his presence as much as possible.But thinking about it, this seems not very safe. Old Bob does not want his children and wife to see his name on the list of the dead tomorrow.He took the initiative and revealed a piece of information: "Miss Witch, your other companions just left on my colleague's helicopter. I guess they should be sent to the Philadelphia Police Department first." "...Thank you." Although she knew that the other party was forced to show her kindness due to the situation, Mina still nodded politely and expressed her gratitude to him.This friendly attitude put Old Bob's heart back into his stomach.He shut his mouth very wisely, acted like a transparent person in his seat, and ignored what was happening in the cabin behind him.Mina, on the other hand, was not so polite to the murderer of Luke's cousin.She raised her hand towards the other party.Suddenly, William Stephen's limbs were spread out in a large character, his body was floating in mid-air, and everything below his neck was wrapped in blue water.

The small whirlpools formed by the water flow were like sharp blades, starting from William Stephen's feet, scraping off the skin and flesh on his body bit by bit.Even though William Stephens was an FBI agent and had received special anti-interrogation training, he still went crazy with pain from this horrific torture.He was racking his brains just now to think about how to survive, but now there was only one thought left in his mind."Kill me, kill me!!!" William Stephen raised his head and shouted like a demon."No, this is the punishment you deserve." Mina's voice was calm. She wore a green bronze mask and her divine appearance floating in the air was somewhat similar to the Aztec high priest who just presided over the sacrificial ceremony in the mirage.Robert, who usually talked a lot, was also frightened by this momentum. He opened his eyes in surprise and looked at his sister who had a completely different temperament from usual.He thought his sister looked so cool now, just like those beautiful witches in movies who used magic to punish their enemies."Ah! Ahhh--" And after enduring more than four hundred knives and the blue water surrounding William Stephen turned completely red, the life of this FBI assistant director who was eager for progress finally came to an end.Before he died, he did not forget to issue the most vicious curse to the Indian siblings in front of him."The federal government and those plutocrats will not let you go. You will end up like Luke Duncan, dead in a corner, and finally the body will be sent to the autopsy table..." "Click." Mina didn't let him continue.With a cold face, she controlled the water flow and broke William Stephen's neck.……at the same time.Near the bank.Luke's huge giant body fell here.The melon-eaters who had been attracted by the vision just now did not have the courage to participate in the battle, but they still had the courage to stand next to the giant's corpse, take photos and check in and upload them to social media.In just ten minutes, someone discovered the business opportunity and more than a dozen photo spots opened nearby.For example, the department store where Chris was previously located was occupied by two groups of gang members because it had a good view and could basically take pictures of the giant's entire body. They charged $50 for a photo.People were cursing and shouting that the giant belonged to everyone, while they readily took out money from their wallets and took great pleasure in making sunken pictures as souvenirs.After all, they didn't want to think back to this night fifty years later, losing the opportunity to take photos and brag to their grandson because they were short of money.Unlike this group of heartless Americans, in the Philadelphia Police Department, the 47-year-old Philadelphia Police Chief Daniel Outlaw is worried.
